fact: A carrion crawler erupts from the earth, drawn by the noise of the rescue.
source_quote: A massive, writhing shape erupted from the earth with a snarl, drawn by the noise of the rescue.
subject: carrion crawler

fact: The carrion crawler resembles a colossal maggot lined with paralyzing tentacles.
source_quote: It was a carrion crawler, a grotesque creature resembling a colossal maggot lined with paralyzing tentacles.
subject: carrion crawler

fact: Zalthir breathes a line of fire, dealing 10 damage to the carrion crawler.
source_quote: Zalthir went first and exhaled a searing line of fire... The crawler blew its Dexterity save and took 10 damage
subject: Zalthir's first fire blast

fact: Zalthir pulls back to position other creatures between himself and the carrion crawler.
source_quote: Zalthir pulled back behind the others
subject: Zalthir

fact: The carrion crawler strikes Gyrgum with a tentacle, dealing 4 damage.
source_quote: The crawler struck Gyrgum with a tentacle for 4 damage and dropped him
subject: Crawler attacks Gyrgum

fact: Gyrgum is dropped by the carrion crawler's attack.
source_quote: The crawler struck Gyrgum with a tentacle for 4 damage and dropped him
subject: Gyrgum

fact: The carrion crawler hits Thorin for 7 damage with its jaws.
source_quote: then turned its snapping jaws on Thorin and hit him for 7
subject: Crawler attacks Thorin

fact: Thorin hits the carrion crawler with his short sword for 4 piercing damage.
source_quote: Thorin answered with a precise thrust of his short sword for 4 piercing damage
subject: Thorin's first attack

fact: Thorin's short sword possesses the Vex property, granting advantage on the next attack.
source_quote: The weapon's Vex property gave him advantage on his next attack
subject: Thorin's short sword

fact: Shuushar, Turvy, Topsy, Sarith, and Buppido fire a volley of bolts, dealing 20 damage.
source_quote: The party's companions, Shuushar, Turvy, Topsy, Sarith, and Buppido, raised their hand crossbows and loosed a volley of bolts into the creature's hide... dealt 20 damage.
subject: Companion volley

fact: Zalthir breathes fire again, but the carrion crawler takes only 2 damage.
source_quote: Zalthir unleashed another blast of fire, but the crawler twisted aside and took only 2 damage
subject: Zalthir's second fire blast

fact: Thorin uses Second Wind to regain 10 hit points.
source_quote: Thorin caught his breath with Second Wind for ten more hit points
subject: Thorin

fact: The carrion crawler's jaws miss Thorin.
source_quote: The crawler's jaws missed Thorin by one point against his AC
subject: Crawler misses Thorin

fact: The carrion crawler's tentacle misses Sarith spectacularly.
source_quote: a tentacle aimed at Sarith "misses spectacularly."
subject: Crawler misses Sarith

fact: Eldeth is nearing death.
source_quote: Meanwhile Eldeth was nearing death
subject: Eldeth

fact: Daz remains stable and keeps rolling successes on death saves.
source_quote: Daz kept rolling successes while staying stable
subject: Daz

fact: Gyrgum rolls death saves.
source_quote: Gyrgum rolled death saves
subject: Gyrgum

fact: Thorin orders Topsy and Turvy to dig out Eldeth and Jimjar.
source_quote: Thorin had Topsy and Turvy dig out Eldeth ("dwarves stick together") and Jimjar
subject: Rescue order

fact: The three remaining companions deal 15 damage, killing the carrion crawler.
source_quote: The three companions still shooting put 15 more damage into the crawler and killed it
subject: Killing the carrion crawler

fact: The carrion crawler is dead.
source_quote: Once it was dead, everyone came round
subject: carrion crawler

fact: Gyrgum is at one hit point.
source_quote: Gyrgum at one hit point
subject: Gyrgum

fact: The party finds no loot on the carrion crawler.
source_quote: There was no loot, so the party harvested the carcass instead
subject: Looting attempt

fact: Gyrgum harvests nine rations from the carrion crawler's corpse.
source_quote: Gyrgum's 2d6 roll produced nine rations, about two days' food with the mushrooms
subject: carrion crawler rations

fact: The harvested rations taste like chicken.
source_quote: the meat tasted remarkably like chicken
subject: carrion crawler rations
